propositions.name: michelson_morley_negative_result
propositions.statement: The Michelson-Morley experiment gives a negative result from interference between two rays, one travelling to and fro in the direction of the earth's motion and the other to and fro in a perpendicular direction.
propositions.quote: negative result of the Michelson-Morley experiment in which interference takes place between two rays, one travelling to and fro in the direction of the earth's motion, and the other to and fro in a perpendicular direction

propositions.name: aether_shares_earths_motion
propositions.statement: The negative result is most naturally interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: is most naturally interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion

propositions.name: stellar_aberration_favours_stationary_aether
propositions.statement: Other phenomena, especially stellar aberration, favour the opposite theory of a stationary aether.
propositions.quote: other phenomena, especially stellar aberration, favour the opposite theory of a stationary aether

propositions.name: fitzgerald_lorentz_contraction
propositions.statement: Solid bodies, such as the stone platform of Michelson's apparatus, alter their relative dimensions when rotated, in such a way as to compensate the optical change that might naturally be looked for.
propositions.quote: solid bodies, such as the stone platform of Michelson's apparatus, alter their relative dimensions, when rotated, in such a way as to compensate the optical change

propositions.name: motion_through_aether_deforms_matter
propositions.statement: A deformation of matter when moving through the aether might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction.
propositions.quote: such a deformation of matter when moving through the rather might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction

propositions.name: double_refraction_can_be_tested_with_delicacy
propositions.statement: The beginning of double refraction can be tested with extraordinary delicacy.
propositions.quote: the beginning of double refraction can be tested with extraordinary delicacy

propositions.name: liquids_show_no_double_refraction_of_expected_order
propositions.statement: For liquids, there is no double refraction of the order to be expected, comparable with the single refraction.
propositions.quote: the conclusion may be stated that there is no double refraction of the order to be expected, that is comparable with 10 of the single refraction

propositions.name: electric_stress_produces_double_refraction_in_liquids
propositions.statement: The liquid condition is no obstacle to the development of double refraction under electric stress.
propositions.quote: the liquid condition is no obstacle to the development of double refraction under electric stress, as is shown in Dr. Kerr's experiments

propositions.name: nicol_polarizes_light_at_angle
propositions.statement: Light is polarized by a nicol in a plane inclined to the horizontal at 45 degrees.
propositions.quote: was polarized by the first nicol in a plane inclined to the horizontal at 45°

propositions.name: board_orientation_sets_transverse_motion
propositions.statement: When the board stands north and south, the earth's motion is transverse and the situation is such as to exhibit any double refraction which may ensue.
propositions.quote: When at 12 o'clock the board stands north and south, the earth's motion is transverse and the situation is such as to exhibit any double refraction which may ensue

propositions.name: vibrations_parallel_and_transverse_may_differ
propositions.statement: Luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion, east and west, might be propagated a little differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion, vertical.
propositions.quote: luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion, i. e. east and west, are propagated a little differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion, i. e. vertical

propositions.name: east_west_orientation_gives_no_double_refraction
propositions.statement: When the board points east and west, both directions of vibration for light passing the tube are transverse to the earth's motion, and therefore no double refraction could manifest itself.
propositions.quote: both directions of vibration for light passing the tube are transverse to the earth's motion, and therefore no double refraction could manifest itself

propositions.name: no_effect_from_180_degree_rotation
propositions.statement: In no case is any effect to be expected from a rotation through 180 degrees.
propositions.quote: In no case is any effect to be expected from a rotation through 180°

propositions.name: ninety_degree_effect_is_second_order
propositions.statement: Any effect from a rotation through 90 degrees must be of the second order in the ratio which expresses the velocity of the earth relatively to that of light.
propositions.quote: such effect as a rotation through 90° may entail must be of the second order in the ratio which expresses the velocity of the earth relatively to that of light

propositions.name: stationary_aether_implies_earth_and_sun_motion_both_matter
propositions.statement: According to the theory of a stationary aether, one has to do not only with the motion of the earth in its orbit, but also with that of the sun in space.
propositions.quote: according to the theory of a stationary aether, we have to do not only with the motion of the earth in its orbit, but also with that of the sun in space

propositions.name: suns_motion_smaller_toward_hercules
propositions.statement: The sun's motion is supposed to be much the smaller and to lie directed towards the constellation Hercules.
propositions.quote: The latter is supposed to be much the smaller, and to lie directed towards the constellation Hercules

propositions.name: april_motions_approximately_conspire
propositions.statement: In the month of April the motion of the earth and the motion of the sun would approximately conspire.
propositions.quote: In the month of April, when successful experiments were first made, the two motions would approximately conspire

propositions.name: strained_glass_produces_double_refraction
propositions.statement: The strained condition of the glass produces just such a double refraction as might be caused by the motion of the liquid through the aether.
propositions.quote: the strained condition of the glass produces just such a double refraction as might be caused by the motion of the liquid through the aether

propositions.name: strain_causes_revival_of_light_except_at_neutral_axis
propositions.statement: A strip of glass in a condition of strain causes revival of light except in the neighbourhood of a horizontal band along the neutral axis.
propositions.quote: causes revival of light except in the neighbourhood of a horizontal band along the "neutral axis."

propositions.name: aether_motion_evidenced_by_band_displacement
propositions.statement: The existence of double refraction due to motion through the aether would be evidenced by a displacement of the dark band upwards or downwards.
propositions.quote: the existence of the latter would be evidenced by a displacement of the dark band upwards or downwards

propositions.name: no_band_shift_observed_in_liquids
propositions.statement: In neither bisulphide of carbon nor water could the slightest shift of the band be seen on rotation of the board from the north-south position to the east-west position, at noon or at 6 p.m.
propositions.quote: In neither case could the slightest shift of the band be seen on rotation of the board from the north-south position to the east-west position, whether at noon or at 6 p.m.

propositions.name: earths_magnetism_rotates_plane_of_polarization
propositions.statement: In consequence of the earth's magnetism there must be a rotation of the plane of polarization when the light traverses the bisulphide of carbon in the north and south position.
propositions.quote: In consequence of the earth's magnetism there must be a rotation of the plane of polarization when the light traverses the bisulphide of carbon in the north and south position

propositions.name: magnetic_rotation_constant_per_cgs_unit
propositions.statement: For one C.G.S. unit of magnetic potential the rotation in bisulphide of carbon at 18 degrees is .042 minute of angle.
propositions.quote: For one C.G.S. unit of magnetic potential the rotation in CS 2 at 18° is .042 minute of angle

propositions.name: earths_horizontal_magnetic_force_value
propositions.statement: The earth's horizontal force is .18, and with a length of 76 cms. this gives the whole rotation to be expected from the earth's magnetism.
propositions.quote: the length is 76 cms. and the earth's horizontal force is .18; so that the whole rotation to be expected is

propositions.name: magnetic_rotation_shows_as_fading_not_displacement
propositions.statement: A small rotation of the plane of polarization would show itself, if at all, by a fading and not by a displacement of the band, and is below the limit of observation.
propositions.quote: So small a rotation of the plane, which would show itself, if at all, by a fading and not by a displacement of the band, is below the limit of observation

propositions.name: revived_light_is_sin_squared_of_nicol_angle
propositions.statement: If theta be the angle of rotation of the nicol found necessary to engender a marked revival of light, the revived light is sin squared theta, expressed as a fraction of the maximum obtainable with parallel nicols.
propositions.quote: If θ be this angle, the revived light is sin²θ, expressed as a fraction of the maximum obtainable with parallel nicols

propositions.name: double_refraction_is_differential_retardation_of_vibrations
propositions.statement: A double refraction causes a retardation of vertical vibrations relatively to horizontal ones.
propositions.quote: the effect of a double refraction causing e. g. a retardation of vertical vibrations relatively to horizontal ones

propositions.name: half_wavelength_retardation_equals_ninety_degree_rotation
propositions.statement: If a retardation amounted to half the wave-length, the effect would be the same as of a rotation of the nicol through 90 degrees.
propositions.quote: If this retardation amounted to ½λ, λ being the wave-length, the effect would be the same as of a rotation of the nicol through 90°

propositions.name: general_law_of_revival_of_light_with_retardation
propositions.statement: A retardation of phase epsilon, in place of pi, gives a revival of light measured by sin squared of half epsilon.
propositions.quote: a retardation of phase ε, in place of π, gives a revival of light measured by sin²(½ε)

propositions.name: four_minute_rotation_causes_marked_fading
propositions.statement: A marked fading of the band attended a rotation of the nicol through 4 minutes.
propositions.quote: It was found that a marked fading of the band attended a rotation of the nicol through 4'

propositions.name: load_induced_double_refraction_same_character_as_sought
propositions.statement: The double refraction due to loads on a compressed strip of glass is of exactly the character to be tested for.
propositions.quote: The double refraction due to the loads is of exactly the character to be tested for

propositions.name: load_induced_retardation_independent_of_length_inverse_of_width
propositions.statement: If the load be given, the effect is independent of the length of the strip and of its thickness along the line of vision, but is inversely as the width.
propositions.quote: If the load be given, the effect is independent of the length of the strip and of its thickness along the line of vision, but is inversely as the width

propositions.name: wertheim_load_retardation_relation
propositions.statement: It requires a load of 10 kilograms per millimetre of width to give a relative retardation of half a wave-length.
propositions.quote: who found that it requires a load of 10 kilograms per millimetre of width to give a relative retardation of ½λ

propositions.name: wavelength_count_across_76cm_bisulphide_of_carbon
propositions.statement: In a length of 76 cm of bisulphide of carbon there are contained 1,200,000 wave-lengths of yellow light, or 2,400,000 half wave-lengths.
propositions.quote: In this length there are contained 1,200,000 wave-lengths of yellow light, or 2,400,000 half wave-lengths

propositions.name: expected_effect_order_of_magnitude
propositions.statement: The effect to be expected is of the order such that there is nearly 100 times to spare compared with the double refraction that might be detected.
propositions.quote: The effect to be expected is of the order 10 , so that there is nearly 100 times to spare

propositions.name: thick_glass_exhibits_double_refraction_from_internal_strains
propositions.statement: A sufficient thickness of plate-glass in one piece is liable to exhibit too much double refraction from the effect of internal strains.
propositions.quote: A sufficient thickness in one piece is liable to exhibit too much double refraction from the effect of internal strains

propositions.name: bisulphide_filling_reduces_internal_reflexions
propositions.statement: Filling the interstices between the faces of plate-glass with bisulphide of carbon sufficiently reduces the internal reflexions.
propositions.quote: The interstices between the faces being filled up with bisulphide of carbon, the internal reflexions were sufficiently reduced

propositions.name: motes_and_threads_adhere_to_glass
propositions.statement: Motes and threads adhere to the glass and become extraordinarily conspicuous.
propositions.quote: One difficulty is to get quit of motes and threads which adhere to the glass and become extraordinarily conspicuous

propositions.name: no_double_refraction_of_expected_order_in_solids
propositions.statement: Even for solids there is no double refraction of the order to be expected due to motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: enough remains to justify us in concluding that even here there is no double refraction (of the order to be expected) due to motion through the aether
